hook: Sabse ameer aur sabse gareeb, MAX aur MIN ne [[expose]] kar diya

slides.title: Ek shot mein [[dono]]
slides.code:
SELECT
  MAX(salary) AS highest,
  MIN(salary) AS lowest
FROM employees;

slides.title: Result [[aa gaya]]
slides.note: Data: Aarav 90k, Kabir 75k, Meera 60k, Riya 50k, Dev **NULL** → ignore

slides.title: Sirf numbers [[nahi]]!
points: SUM/AVG ke ulat, yahan text bhi chalega ✅
slides.note: Sabse naya joiner? **MAX(join_date)**. Bas itna hi 😎

slides.title: Topper ka [[naam]] bhi?
slides.note: Pehle MAX nikalo, phir **usi salary wali row** pakdo. Ties bhi aa jayenge

slides.why: PostgreSQL/SQL Server: **error**. Purana MySQL: koi bhi **random naam** 💀
